scope: Read-only diagnosis of the completed expanded reference, not a new actor episode or policy change.

semantic_failure.claim: Unique static pack IDs prevent runtime duplicate packs; declaring nonUserVisibleDescriptions filters Fast Path entries.
semantic_failure.contradiction: The new constant is neither used nor exported. The original runtime matcher and audit output remain unchanged in the public-issue fixture.

control_stall.error: A changed workspace or failed test needs a successful test before done.
control_stall.interpretation: Repeated policy rejection with no new program evidence. It is not replay of one identical prompt or proof of a physical cache defect.

causal_boundaries: An exact edit/tool success does not certify changed task behavior.
The finish gate enforces a necessary verification condition, not a liveness or hypothesis-revision policy.
A successful developer test alone would not certify the two issue requirements; relevance of the assertions and the unchanged official evaluator remain necessary.
Accepting the first finish would submit the same incorrect patch; fewer refusals would not repair its semantics.
The bundled budget/tool/history intervention does not isolate effects of individual changes.
No claim of intrinsic impossibility for the fixed actor, nor guaranteed success under an untested workflow, follows from this trace.
not_executed: No new model request, GPU run, hidden-evaluator query, training, source-code modification or automatic test injection.
No early-stop policy, workflow rewrite, extra planner, forced action or task-specific hint was installed.
next_decision: Before further quality runs, define an explicitly authorized hypothesis-to-reproduction-to-correction protocol and test whether the same actor can autonomously generate relevant behavioral evidence. This is a new agent workflow, not a numerical budget adjustment.
